steps.name: Farewell, Old Man (1)
steps.objective: Turn in the quest to [Liz] in 「Belfa Library」.

steps.name: Farewell, Old Man (2)
steps.objective: Talk to [Liz] in 「Belfa Library」, then turn in the quest to [Lif] in 「Lifthrasir」.

lines.text: (Somewhere between the cracks of time, at a moment impossible to place precisely.)

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: (Stares blankly.)

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Snap out of it.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Huh...

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: You're completely out of it.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: (Smack.)

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Ow! That hurt!!

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Feeling awake now?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Liz, put that book down before we talk.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Last time you zoned out while resting, you absorbed the harmful magic pouring in from the Sea of Emptiness, remember?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Well, that...

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: A librarian as sensitive to magic as you must stay alert. Otherwise, harmful energy will consume you.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Sorry. I didn't do it on purpose.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: That's why this will be difficult for you. If you enter the playground, the worst could happen.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: I've already asked for help, so don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Who did you ask? Oh, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Pel. Hello, Liz.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: R-Roar...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Roar?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: I just remembered the saying about how a tiger comes when you... roar.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Was that a common saying in Elias? Roar.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Since you're here, Hefring must have delivered the letter properly. Roar.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was surprised when Hefring suddenly appeared with a letter in its mouth.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Pel recruited Hefring when it flew to the playground. He said, 'Hefring, you seem to have talent. Why not work with us?'

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: We provide three meals a day, regular snacks, and pet insurance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's nice. Why did you call me?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Inspiration has gone missing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you mean the old spirit Hermit, whom the Belpha librarians call their inspiration, he's right here...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Not that old fellow. 'Inspiration.' To those with magic, it's a spiritual sense. Usually, it means a flash of a clever idea or stimulus when creating something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... Can I help you find that kind of inspiration?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Of course. You've already prevented the world's destruction several times.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Pel, explain the [Playground of Inspiration] to %s. I'll stop the toy cars and planes trying to get in here.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: All right. Thanks.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Playground of Inspiration? A playground inside the library?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: That's right. Leda, god of knowledge, loved children dearly and wanted to teach them many things.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: So when the library was founded, many spaces were made for children. The playground is one of them.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: It's full of toys and play equipment, so children love it. Adults visit too, saying the view of the Sea of Emptiness clears their minds.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Writers and artists especially said they found great inspiration there. Eventually, it became known as the [Playground of Inspiration].

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But why is it so noisy now?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Someone's enormous inspiration remained in the playground and inhabited the toys and equipment.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: It also created something like a huge golem, which is a real headache. Sigh...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: If those things get inside, they'll wreck everything. Keeping the books organized every day is already exhausting!!

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: No, more importantly, if they mix with the knowledge inside, something terrible...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What will happen?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: The flow of knowledge that sustains the world will stop and become contaminated. People will believe false things are true.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: But the librarians are holding them back as best they can, so we're all right for now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go defeat the golem.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Wait, adventurer! If you go directly, the inspiration will run wild. We need to identify its owner and prepare properly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pel, do you know anything about its owner?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: The famous author Clara. She held a book signing at the library recently, and afterward the playground became like this. But I don't know where she is now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've met her in Lifthrasir. I'll ask Director Lif.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Really? Thank you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nothing. I'll be back as soon as I can.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Phew. Those Tire Men and mini cars are relentless. I can't understand what they're saying either.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Liz, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: We should hold out for a few days. Where's the adventurer?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Went to see the author Clara.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: I hope they find a way quickly... Huh, what's this book? A signed copy by Clara?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Yes, her new book. Volume one of The Regressed Queen of a Fallen Kingdom Doesn't Hide That She's a Witch. You've read it, right?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: They gave these to everyone at the signing... Did someone leave it behind? Give it here. I'll find the owner.
「To Kaina Dawn Silvaria. Wishing you happiness.」

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Oh... Her Majesty was here...?

steps.name: Farewell, Old Man (3)
steps.objective: Talk to [Lif] in 「Lifthrasir」, then find [Clara] in 「Crystal Moon Forest」. After the conversation, return to 「Belfa Library」 and turn in the quest to [Liz].

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Director.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Director?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Oh, %s. Welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What were you doing?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Thinking about a village matter. Oh, you know Clara, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Perfect timing...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I do.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Clara held a signing for her new book at Belpha Library. I thought it went well, but she seemed strangely listless.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: When I asked, she said she was sitting in the playground thinking about her next book. The children thought she'd fainted and shook her awake.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Fainted?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: She thought she'd closed her eyes for a moment... But several hours had passed. So she left the library and returned to the village...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Since then, she can't remember any of the ideas for her next work. She can't even write the next part of her current manuscript.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Even if she forces herself to sit and write, her hand won't move.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I checked whether any mischievous spirits were around her, just in case, but that wasn't it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: %s, you know something, don't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly explain the situation at Belpha Library to Lif.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Sigh. So that's what happened. And Clara doesn't even know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Would it be all right if I went to see her?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It should be.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is Clara?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: She went for a walk in the Crystal Moon Forest. She's always in the same spot, so you'll find her easily.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll talk with her and look for a solution.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Thank you, %s. Please look after our Clara.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Normally, you'd keep recommending something related to Lifthrasir, but not today.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Hehe. I'm not some unscrupulous director who talks about nothing else.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: You must be busy, so hurry to Clara. I'll give you your appointment as Lifthrasir's goodwill ambassador next time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll tell you if I ever feel like becoming an ambassador. Goodbye for now.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Yes, take care.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Is the library director away? This much should be easy to subdue...

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I haven't written a single line in days. This has never happened before... I feel like an idiot.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: The goblin goes gobble-gobble. The kobold goes kobble-kobble... Ah, that's not what I wanted to write...

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Clara.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: ...Hello. It's been a while.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Trying to go inside again...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, that's not it... Um...

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I'm in the middle of something. Excuse me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Clara, wait. You went to Belpha Library recently, right?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I did visit the Playground of Inspiration...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Clara about the situation at Belpha Library.)

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: My inspiration is rampaging there? That sounds strange...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Inspiration comes and goes. If you don't jot down an idea when it appears, it simply vanishes.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: If you don't express it, it doesn't exist... So how could it come out and cause trouble? That's impossible.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Impossible or not, it really happened. If we don't deal with it properly...

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: There's more...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain the worst-case scenario Pel described.)

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I have no magic. I can't even see spirits...
(Just then, something falls from the tree beside Clara.)
Thud!

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: That startled me...

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Squaaawk...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daniel?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Oh, we meet again, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daniel, what are you doing here?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: I followed the scent of a scoop all the way here, squawk. Hmm, this woman has the scent.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: ...Saying I smell is rude, chick.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: I'm a parrot, not a chick, squawk. And that's not the kind of smell I mean, Clara.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: You know me?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Hehe, of course. Knowing famous people is part of a reporter's job.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: You heard everything, didn't you...? Are you going to write an article?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: It's certainly a scoop, but I, Daniel, never write without permission from the people involved. Still, I've thought of a headline. Would you like to hear it?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: 「Shocking! Famous Author Enjoys Rampage in Library!」

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: No. I refuse.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: How about this revised version? 「Bestselling Author Ruined by Lack of Inspiration.」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who taught you to write headlines like that?
(Daniel takes a book from his bag and holds it up.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Rosengarten Monthly... You'll really be ruined if you write articles like the ones in there.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: %s, please help me. I can't keep eating dirt every day, squawk!

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Lady Lydia, the demigod, said to bring her one proper article if I wanted something tasty to eat!!
(As Daniel flaps, something falls from between the pages of Rosengarten Monthly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's this?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Oh, so that's where it was. This is sticky paper for catching invisible things like ghosts, squawk.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: You said you've visited Rosengarten, %s, so you must have seen them. You know the Souls that look like plastic bags?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: If left alone, they float about, so I stuck them to this and gathered them up. It's especially precious because only I can use it...

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Those are memories now... Ah, Rosengarten is gone...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: %s, wait. Quiet. Could that catch my rampaging inspiration too?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, good idea. Shall we try?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Hey, chick... I mean, parrot. Daniel, was it?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: That's right, squawk.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I'll help you write your article, so come report from the scene with us.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Th-Thank you! Daniel the parrot reporter is d-deeply moved, squawk!

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Oh, a scoop! The scent of a scoop never lies...

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: %s, let's go to the library and catch my inspiration with that sticky paper...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...That sounds a little odd, but let's try.

steps.name: Farewell, Old Man (4)
steps.objective: Talk to [Liz] in 「Belfa Library」, then defeat monsters in 「Zisk Plains」 to obtain 5 <Zisk Blueberries>. Then turn in the quest to [Daniel] in 「Belfa Library」.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: So that's what happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Still, this is remarkable. If a lesser demon had even the slightest ill intent...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: He'd have screamed in agony the moment he entered.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Look at him admiring the library with sparkling eyes. A parrot reporter hunting a scoop. How cute.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Lady Lydia gave her permission too, so it should be fine.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: If it isn't, I'll deal with him.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: One blow should be enough, right?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: I'd have to try to know...

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: H-How can you say such frightening things right in front of me, squawk?!

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Don't panic. Just don't do anything bad.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: For something from the Demon Realm, it doesn't seem to have harmful energy.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: The parrot butlers worked all night making it without minimum wage or overtime pay, squawk!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Good grief...

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Reporter Daniel.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: When we're done reporting from the scene, I'll also give you an interview about my new book.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Understood! Thank you very much, squawk!

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I'm counting on you as our sticky parrot too.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Understood! Huh? Sticky parrot?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Nothing...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pel, Liz. Which way is the playground?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Straight down the corridor on the lower floor. Huh?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: What's wrong, Liz?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Perhaps because the author is here, the toys and playground equipment seem more active.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: But Mr. Reporter, your stomach keeps rumbling.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: I haven't eaten anything but dirt for days... Squawk...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, then I'll share some of my food. Will this do?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: You're the best, %s!

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: A parrot... No, Daniel the parrot reporter eats human food...?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: I'd eat it if I had any! I really don't... Sob.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: %s, about the sticky paper Daniel is holding. I didn't think one sheet would be enough, so I made several. Take them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Pel.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: We're counting on you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then we'll go once Daniel finishes eating.

steps.name: Farewell, Old Man (5)
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Daniel] in 「Belfa Library」, then enter 「Playground of Inspiration」.
2. Defeat [Inspired Tire Man] in 「Playground of Inspiration」 and resolve the situation, then go outside and turn in the quest to [Daniel].

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Phewww! Thank you for the meal, squawk! Now I can give this report my all!

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Let me see the sticky paper. If I do this...
(Clara gathers the sheets and sticks them all over Daniel's body.)

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Ready...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can we go in now?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Oh! A scoop awaits. A scoop, squawk!

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: We have a hero with us in case anything happens, so we'll be fine.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Am I, Daniel, the hero? Or...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you mean me?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Aren't you a hero? You've resolved all sorts of dangerous situations. That's why I called you that.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Let's go. The hero beats down the rampaging inspiration, and the reporter catches it with sticky paper.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: What will you do, author?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Observe.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Oh, observe. Very good...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, I planned to protect you, so don't worry. We're going in now. Both of you, stay close behind me.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Understood, squawk!

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: But what does 'observe' mean? Are we being served up as dinner, squawk?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: It means I'll watch. No one's serving you up.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Observe, observe. I really thought we were done for.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So this is the Playground of Inspiration...

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Oh, is this the Playground of Inspiration? There are so many toys and rides, squawk.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Sea of Emptiness is clearly visible from here. That wide-open view makes me feel as though a weight has lifted.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: When I come to Belpha Library, I sometimes look out at the sea from here. It often gives me good ideas.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Huh? I hear something strange...

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Squaaawk! Toy planes, toy horses, mini cars, even a slide are coming at us!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daniel, calm down.
(The cardboard airplane circling above Clara's head stops.)

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Are you my inspiration?
(At Clara's words, the still airplane tries to fly past the group and out of the playground.)

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: %s, catch it.
(%s's attack crumples the cardboard airplane, sending it to the ground.)
Squawk.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Huh? The airplane made a squawking sound and dropped something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's that?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I can't see it...

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: I've caught it on the sticky paper, squawk! Can you see it now?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: It looks like a sparkling marble... Let's see...

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Oh, the marble disappeared.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: ...This is definitely my inspiration. I remembered the part of my manuscript where I was stuck...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: What happens in the story, squawk?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: The hero dies after being hit by a carriage whose driver fell asleep.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: But a goddess appears, says it isn't time to die yet, and offers another chance at life...

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: When the hero opens their eyes, they've become an immensely powerful demon. And they're on the way to the Demon Realm after kidnapping a princess.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Isn't kidnapping princesses usually the Demon King's job, squawk?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Then...

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: S-Squawk!! Author, hurry! What happens next? Next?!

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: ...My inspiration is gone, so I can't remember the rest... We need to find more of it in the playground.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: I'll find every bit of that inspiration. No, I'll stick it all over my body, squawk!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So I'll defeat them, and Daniel can bring it back.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: %s, I feel strange. My stomach is turning... We've only found one little piece of inspiration...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You won't suddenly faint like last time, will you?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Sorry. I don't know...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then wait outside.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: %s, hurry! Inspiration awaits! We need to finish quickly, squawk!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daniel, it's dangerous to go alone. Let's stay together!

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Pant, pant. With so many inspiration marbles stuck to me, I'm getting heavy...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daniel, hold on a little longer.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: For the sake of hearing the rest of the author's story...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shouldn't the exclusive interview come first?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Oh, right! The scoop comes first, squawk!
Squee.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Squee?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: %s, why are you trying to sound cute?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wasn't trying to be cute. There was a strange sound...
Squeeeee!
(With that strange sound, a huge shadow falls before Daniel and %s.)
Thud!
Squee!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Move, Daniel!

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Squaaawk! You saved me, %s. What just flew at us? A tire...?
Squeeeee!
(With a cute cry, a monster made entirely of tires appears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That is...

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: It calls itself the Inspired Tire Man, squawk! Let me listen.

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: Squee! Squee! Squeeeee!

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: 'Because I was a used tire, I sat in a corner with nothing to do! But I obtained tremendous inspiration and magic, and awakened!'

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: 'Now I will conquer the playground and found a tire kingdom! And play with the children!'
(The Inspired Tire Man nods.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Should we believe that...?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: It doesn't seem to be lying.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But Daniel, how do you understand Tire Man?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: When I was unemployed in the Demon Realm, I earned level two on the Monster-Language Proficiency Test, the MLPT, to prepare for job hunting.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Level two is quite useful for reporting too. There are many people in the Demon Realm you can't communicate with...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What kind of place is the Demon Realm...?)

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: Squee! Squee! Squeeeee!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems more threatening now... Daniel, what is it saying?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: 'Leave the inspiration and get lost, squawk!'

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: A piece of playground equipment with such a cute face using such foul language! Unforgivable!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you going to do, Daniel?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: %s, teach that Tire Man a lesson right now!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, of course...

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: Squeeeee! Squee-squee!!
(As Tire Man waves its arms, fierce winds sweep through the area.)

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: 'You noisy parrot! Fly even higher than Freios, squawk!'

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Am I about to be blown away?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Squaaawk! I'm flying away! I can't flyyyyy...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daniel? Daniel!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He flew so far he looks like a star in the sky...

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: Squee! Squee! Squee-squee-squee!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you saying? Don't tell me...

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: Squee! Squee! Squee-squeeeee!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think it's saying, 'Get lost already!'

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: Squee.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And if I refuse?

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: Squeeeee! Squee!
(Tire Man's roar echoes so loudly it seems to fill the Sea of Emptiness.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh, Tire Man. I can't leave you like this anyway, but that squeaking is getting on my nerves.

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: Squeeeee!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Tire Man. Prepare to have the wind knocked out of you!!

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: Squeeeee!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Squeee! I mean, take this!
(Tire Man is driven back by %s's attack.)

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: Squeeee...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It doesn't look anywhere close to falling.
Pop.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pop? What's that sound?

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: Squee?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is air escaping somewhere...?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: I pulled out the flag on Tire Man's head, and now it's losing air, squawk.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daniel? Weren't you blown away?

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: Squee? Squee?! Squeeeee!
(As the air begins escaping, Tire Man panics and loses its composure.)

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Hehe. If you lose air this easily, you're not Tire Man. You're Inner Tube Man!

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: Squeeeee! Squeeeee!
(Tire Man desperately tries to cover the hole with its arms, but cannot stop the leak.)

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: %s, finish it! Finish it off! Tire Man, not me, squawk!
(At Daniel's words, the adventurer gathers strength and strikes Tire Man.)
Boom.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Wow, %s! You're the best. You turned that oversized fool back into scrap tires!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew. It's over.

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: Squeee...

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Tire Man must be the same kind as the others. It went 'squeee' and dropped an inspiration marble.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The marble is stuck to your body too, Daniel, so we're finished.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Phew, what a relief.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how did you get back? The wind blew you away.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: I flapped my way back, squawk.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Didn't you say you couldn't fly?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: The parrot clan has never flown, so I never thought I could either.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: My arms are a little numb. Squaaawk! Don't touch them! I've got a cramp!! Squaaaaawk!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry, Daniel.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Then let me have exclusive rights to write articles about you, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shall we go?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Just an interview...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aren't you coming?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Aww, my scoop...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm joking. We'll do it later, though. I promise.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Yay! You promised, squawk! The goddess will scold you if you take it back! Squaaawk, did you touch my arm again?!

steps.name: Farewell, Old Man (6)
steps.objective: Talk to [Daniel] and [Pel] in 「Belfa Library」, then turn in the quest to [Pel] in 「Belfa Library」.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Author Clara, your inspiration is back!
(Daniel shakes his whole body in front of Clara, dislodging the inspiration marbles.)

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Why is there so much...?
(Each time Clara touches a sparkling marble, it vanishes with a clear, lovely sound.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Clara, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: It feels like a child who ran away has come home. Did Mom feel this way when I ran away?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: I'm sure your mother understood! So, so, what happens next?!

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: That would be a spoiler. I'm not telling.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Author, that's worse than giving me delicious food and taking it away! Only demons worse than me would...

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Daniel, if someone asked for a magazine or newspaper carrying your article for free, would you give it to them? Shouldn't they pay properly? You said you live on dirt...

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Sob, sob. I don't want to eat dirt... I want delicious food...

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Daniel, you aren't a bad demon.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Oh, demon. I'm not a demon. I'm a talking parrot beastfolk. I'm good at repeating what you say.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: You're denying it now...? Never mind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha...

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Thank you, everyone.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: You found all my inspiration. I think I can write without trouble now.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: So... Let's do that interview.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Really, squawk?!

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Have you spent your whole life being deceived?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: ...Yes. In the Demon Realm, I was always being deceived. There were job scams too...

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Here, everyone tries to look after me. I'm bewildered.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: There are bad people in the world, but good people too... So, do you want the interview or not?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Author, may I begin the interview now?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Yes. Hurry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: While you two do the interview, I'll tell the librarians the playground problem is resolved.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Yay! An interview! Squawk, squawk! Author, I'll begin the questions now!

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: When did the girl called Clara first show a talent for writing? And when did you first want to publish a book? And...

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: When was that...? Around four or five years old? Since then...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: I'm glad Clara recovered all her inspiration...

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: We kept calling for inspiration, and the old Hermits gathered around. That was a problem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could something like this happen again?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: I can't guarantee anything, but the possibility isn't zero.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: There must be other people besides Clara full of inspiration. We'll watch more carefully to keep this from happening...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you need my help, contact me again.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Just hearing that is reassuring.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: This isn't much, but please accept this small payment in Ely.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Please take it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don't have to...

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: If you leave without it, the director will scold us for calling someone who was already busy.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: ...Liz, I don't want to be scolded...

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Pull yourself together, Pel. Honestly, I don't want to be scolded either...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll gratefully accept.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: What a relief...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (How exactly does the director scold these two?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The interview is taking longer than expected.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: If you're busy, you can head back first. If you have a message for Clara, we'll pass it on.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: We have something to tell her too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really? I don't have much to say. Oh, tell her I hope the manuscript goes well. And that I'll see her later.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Of course. We'll tell her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then goodbye.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Travel safely.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: ...When will the director return?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Who knows...

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Oh, here comes the author.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Librarian, is the room I used before vacant?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Yes, it is.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Daniel has given me some good material, so we'll have a canned writing retreat together...

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Canned? Canned! What kind of food is it, squawk? (Eyes sparkle.)

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Oh, I don't think that's what a writer means by 'canned'...

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Then what does it mean?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: It means staying inside, or being unable to leave, until the manuscript is finished...

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Am I getting canned too, squawk?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Yes. Canned.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: You have MLPT level two, so you could talk with the rampaging Tire Man. And from your article, you seem talented... Want to work for me?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: MLPT level two?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Impressive. That must have helped resolve the playground incident. Help us with our work sometime too.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Hmm... I'm a reporter, squawk... I only like canned things when I can eat them...

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I'll provide room, board, snacks, and a salary...
(Clara whispers the amount of the salary into Daniel's ear.)

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: ...At that rate, I could make a living without hunting scoops!

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: But you must help me write exclusive articles later too!

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I promise.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Librarian, could I ask for the same arrangement as before?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Canned, canned! Delicious food!!
(In the end, Daniel enters the workroom with Clara, singing about canned food.)
(You later hear that he could not leave the library until long after the new book was finished.)

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Sob, sob. I've been deceived again, squawk...
